correctness.rationale: The Catalan number C_n has v2(C_n)=s2(n+1)-1 by Legendre. Expand each independently signed matching weight as product(1-2I_negative_edge). Prescribing r disjoint noncrossing chords splits residual matchings into Catalan products over r+1 complementary regions; the binary digit-sum inequality shows each term (-2)^r*product C_m is divisible by 2^(s2(n+1)-1). At the all-positive signing the exact 2-adic valuation is attained; an odd prime cannot divide all Walsh coefficients, since Walsh inversion over F_p would make the nonzero indicator identically zero. If C_n is odd every signed sum is odd. Otherwise the anti-reflection choice of root-chord signs pairs and cancels terms for even n, and for odd n uses a recursively zero-signed pair of central half-polygons, because (n+1)/2 remains non-dyadic. Vertex switching yields orbits of size 2^(2n-1), since the eligible chord graph is connected K_{n,n}. An independent polygon dynamic program exhaustively checked all frequencies for n<=4 (zero counts n2=8, n4=15104) and reflection witnesses to n=79, distinct from the pinned full checker. Finite checks support, but do not replace, the all-n reflection and valuation proofs.

value.rationale: It resolves a natural dichotomy for the entire family of Catalan noncrossing perfect matching codes: when the full Walsh convolution is invertible, when it has a kernel, and a uniform exponential lower bound on that kernel when singular. Exact dyadic gcd and reflection witnesses connect Catalan arithmetic, geometry and Fourier inversion, beyond restating a Catalan parity fact.

final_claim: For the unnormalized Walsh transform of convex 2n-gon noncrossing perfect matchings with independently signed parity-opposite chords, the exact gcd of all multipliers is 2^(s_2(n+1)-1), and zero multipliers exist precisely when n+1 is not a power of two, then in vertex-switch orbits of at least 2^(2n-1) frequencies.
limitations: Does not count every zero at arbitrary n nor determine least surviving coefficient. All-length proof depends on the geometric region decomposition and reflection induction, not extrapolation of finite tests.
residual_risks: A general theorem for arbitrary chord-dependent signed Catalan sums outside the inspected material could imply the gcd law. Gao–Gu and Kemp full texts were not obtained here; no universal priority guarantee.
